plain.li: Boots on, we're walking out.
Come on, nobody stays behind for this one.
[grave] They'd want us all there.

warm.li: Take your time getting ready, we'll wait for you.
Give me your hand on the rough bits.

cheerful.li: Out we go, it's a fine day for it.
Last one to the gate carries the water.

gloomy.li: Come on, before I change my mind.
Let's go, it won't get easier waiting.

cold.li: We leave now and we're back before dark.
Two lines, stay together.

plain.li: Wait for the slow ones.
[fields] Smell that, it's the fields.
[water] The water's high this year.

warm.li: Lean on me if your knee's bad.
It's nice, all of us out at once.

cheerful.li: Someone start a song, it's a long way.
Look, a bird, there.

gloomy.li: We used to be more, on walks like these.
My feet will hate me tomorrow.

cold.li: Keep to the path.
Eyes on the tree line.

plain.li: Bring something warm, we'll be out all night.
Take a turn when you're ready, there's room.
[grave] Nobody should be alone tonight, not even them.

warm.li: I'll sit first, you come when you can.
We'll take turns, so everyone gets some rest.

blunt.li: Grab a blanket, we're sitting up.

cheerful.li: A night up together, I'll bring the stories.
Who's for a long night and a big pot of tea?

gloomy.li: Someone has to sit up, it may as well be us.
It'll be a long night, bring your patience.

cold.li: Watches of two hours, I'll take the first.
Nobody sleeps on watch.

plain.li: Pass the blanket along.
Is that dawn coming, or just hope?
[beside] Rest, {OTHER_nameDef}, we've got you.

warm.li: Sleep a little, I'll wake you.
You're not alone out here.

cheerful.li: Halfway through the night already.
I've counted every star, starting again.

gloomy.li: The cold gets in no matter what you wear.
I keep thinking I hear something.

cold.li: Your turn to watch.
Nothing yet, keep looking.

plain.li: Everyone take a direction and call out if you find it.
Meet back here before dark.

warm.li: Go in pairs, nobody gets lost looking.
Thank you for coming out to help.

cheerful.li: A search party, how exciting!
I'll find it, I've got sharp eyes.

gloomy.li: Let's look, for all the good it'll do.
We'll try, at least.

cold.li: Work outward from here, in a line.
Mark where you've looked.

plain.li: Not under here either.
Has anyone looked by the rocks?

warm.li: We'll find it, keep going.
Rest a minute, then we'll look again.

cheerful.li: Warmer, I think, maybe.
I found a nice stone, does that count?

gloomy.li: It's gone, I'm sure of it.
We'll be out here all day for nothing.

cold.li: That ground's covered, next section.
Slower, you'll miss it at that pace.

plain.li: I'll run this out and come straight back.
[other] Taking this to {OTHER_nameDef}.

warm.li: It'll do them good, I'll take it now.
I'm happy to carry it, it's on my way.

cheerful.li: Special delivery, make way!
I'll be the fastest courier in the colony.

gloomy.li: I'll take it, though we could use it ourselves.
Off it goes, then.

cold.li: I'll see it handed over properly.
I'll make sure it gets there, and to the right hands.

plain.li: This is from the colony.
[other] {OTHER_nameDef}, this is for you.

warm.li: We thought of you, take it.
From all of us, with love.

blunt.li: Take it before I drop it.

cheerful.li: Surprise, it's for you!
Hope you like it, I carried it all the way.

gloomy.li: It's not much, but here.
Here, for what it's worth.

cold.li: Delivered as agreed.
That settles our part.

plain.li: I'm going out for meat, back by dark.
[lowtech] Spear, bow, and a sharp knife.

warm.li: Keep supper warm, I'll bring something back.
Don't worry, I'll be careful out there.

cheerful.li: Hunting day, my favorite!
Wish me luck, I'm feeling lucky.

gloomy.li: Somebody has to do it.
I'll go, but I won't like it.

cold.li: I'll take the safe one, nothing that bites back.
Back by sundown, with or without.

plain.li: Still, still, wait for it.
It's seen me, no, it hasn't.

warm.li: Thank you for the meal.
Easy, it's over now.

cheerful.li: That's supper sorted!
Wait till they see this.

gloomy.li: Poor thing never saw it coming.
I don't enjoy this part.

cold.li: Downwind, quiet, now.
One shot, as planned.

plain.li: Let them finish.
I've never heard it told that way.

warm.li: That was beautifully said.
We're all listening, take your time.

cheerful.li: Tell it again tomorrow!
I got goosebumps at the end.

gloomy.li: I'll be thinking about that for a while.
True, every word of it, more's the pity.

cold.li: Worth hearing.
I'll hold you to that.

plain.li: Who knows the next verse?
[child] Sing the one with the fox in it.

warm.li: Sing it again, slower this time.
That one always makes me think of home.

cheerful.li: Louder, everyone!
One more, then one more after that.

gloomy.li: We used to sing this with more voices.
I can't sing this one, not anymore.

cold.li: The tune is right, the words are wrong.
Keep time, at least.

plain.li: Someone say their name, out loud.
I brought their old cup.

warm.li: They were the best of us.
I'm glad we all came.

cheerful.li: Remember when they fell in the pond?
They'd have laughed at all of us crying.

gloomy.li: Another year without them.
I can't remember their voice anymore.

cold.li: They did their part, and more.
We remember, that's what this is for.

plain.li: Who's dealing?
Somebody find the dice.

warm.li: I'm so glad we're all here.
Come on, join us, there's room.

cheerful.li: Best night we've had in ages!
Dance, nobody's watching, everyone's watching.

gloomy.li: It'll be back to work tomorrow.
Somebody's missing from this.

cold.li: Good for spirits, I'll grant it.
An hour more, then bed.

warm.li: Budge up, there's room by the fire.
Warm your hands, you're freezing.

cheerful.li: I could sit here forever.
Who wants to roast something on a stick?

gloomy.li: It'll be ashes by morning.
The dark's right there, past the light.

cold.li: Keep it small, we've wood for a week.
Mind the sparks near the stores.

plain.li: Sleeves up, everyone, it won't take long with all of us.
[repair] Anything that's cracked, we fix today.

cheerful.li: Work party, I'll bring the songs!

gloomy.li: Let's get it over with.

cold.li: Pairs, and nobody stands idle.
I've split the jobs, find your name.

plain.li: We went out together and came back together, which is the whole point, I think.
Walked out with the others today, at the pace of the slowest, and that was the best of it.

warm.li: Somebody took my arm on the way back without being asked. I keep thinking about it.

blunt.li: Long walk. Worth it, I suppose.

cheerful.li: We walked out together, and the little ones ran ahead the whole way.

gloomy.li: We walked out and back. The colony looked small from out there, and far away.

cold.li: The walk did what it was meant to do. People were quieter afterward, and kinder.

plain.li: The walk for {NAME} never happened. Everyone was busy, or said they were.
I waited by the gate for the others until the light changed, then walked back in.

warm.li: We meant to walk out together for {NAME}. Next time I'll go and fetch people myself.

cheerful.li: The walk fell through. I went round the walls on my own and called it close enough.

gloomy.li: Another plan that came to nothing.

plain.li: Sat up all night with the others. The dawn came slow, and then all at once.
A long night's watch. We took turns sleeping against each other's shoulders.

warm.li: We kept watch together, shoulder to shoulder in the dark, and that mattered.

blunt.li: Up all night. Tired. It was right to do.

cheerful.li: We saw the sun come up together after the vigil. I've never seen one so pretty.

gloomy.li: A cold night of watching. I don't know what we were waiting for, only that we had to.

cold.li: The vigil was kept. I'll be useless today, and so will the others.

plain.li: We were meant to sit up together for {NAME}. In the end everyone just went to bed.

warm.li: The vigil never came together. I lit a candle by my bed instead and kept it a little while.

blunt.li: Vigil fell through. Went to bed.

cheerful.li: No vigil this time, but I said a few words out loud on my own, and that felt good.

gloomy.li: Nobody came to keep the watch. I sat up a while, then gave up.

cold.li: The vigil wasn't kept. I'll mention it at the next meeting.

plain.li: Searched half the day with the others. My legs ache from all the stooping.
We combed every field and ditch. I know this land better now, if nothing else.

warm.li: Half a dozen of us turned out for the search, and the grumblers kept it to themselves.

cheerful.li: Search party today! I found three things nobody had lost, and one thing somebody had.

gloomy.li: We searched until the light went. I kept expecting the worst under every bush.

cold.li: The search was thorough. I made sure of it.

plain.li: The search for {NAME} never got going. Too much else to do, they said.

warm.li: I wish we'd gone looking. I'll keep an eye out on my own.

cheerful.li: We never searched, but I'll keep looking whenever I'm out that way.

gloomy.li: We didn't even look. I don't know what that says about us.

cold.li: The search was dropped. A waste of the chance.

plain.li: Took what we'd promised out the gate today. It felt good to hand it over.
Carried our gift across the whole colony. My arms are still complaining.

warm.li: Handed it over and saw their face. That's the best part of giving anything.

cheerful.li: I was the one who carried it! I've decided that makes it partly my gift.

gloomy.li: We gave it away. I hope we don't need it this winter.

cold.li: Handed over in full. Our side of the bargain is kept.

plain.li: What we meant to send for {NAME} is still in the storeroom.

warm.li: We never took it out to them. I feel bad about that.

cheerful.li: The errand never happened, so at least the stores are full.

gloomy.li: We said we'd give it and we didn't. People will remember that.

cold.li: The delivery wasn't made. Someone will ask why, and I'll have no good answer.

plain.li: Went out after game today. Came back with meat and wet boots.
A long stalk and a quick end. There'll be a good stew tomorrow.

warm.li: Shared the best cuts with the ones who needed them most.

cheerful.li: I brought it down with the first shot, and nobody saw, so I'm writing it here.

gloomy.li: Hunted today. I can still see its eyes.

cold.li: Clean hunt. Nothing wasted.

plain.li: The hunt for {NAME} never went out. The pot will be thin tonight.

warm.li: We didn't hunt in the end. Maybe it's for the best.

cheerful.li: No hunt today, so the animals get another day of sunshine.

gloomy.li: Nobody went hunting. We'll feel it later.

cold.li: The hunt was called off. Meat will be short.

plain.li: The work party for {NAME} came to nothing. I did a little on my own.

warm.li: We never got everyone together for the work. Next time I'll go round and ask each of them.

blunt.li: Work party never happened. The work's still there.

cheerful.li: The work party fell through. It'll keep till tomorrow.

gloomy.li: Nobody turned up to help. I'm not surprised.

cold.li: The work party didn't form. Everyone had a reason, none of them good.
